component: Account Hub manual configuration title updates

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The manual form selects an IMAP or POP3 Fluent title from configData.incoming?.type. Other values pass no ID, so setTitle removes title-id. The observed-attribute path clears the old title’s localization ID, arguments and text before applying a replacement. Direct tests check both protocol IDs and title clearing; they do not establish rendered localization or screen-reader output.
title: Manual configuration titles follow the incoming type and clear for other types
